title: Can deceiving patients be morally acceptable?
original_text:
Can deceiving patients be morally acceptable?
Daniel K Sokol argues that on rare occasions benignly deceiving patients can be morally acceptable, and he has devised a decision checklist to help doctors facing such a dilemma The trail contains punctal occlusion surgery.
